A lively session began when an early surprise was first spotted by an experienced planner Incident Report: Companion Animal Travel Desk Transit Review

A routine review at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways quickly shifted into urgent action when a companion animal reservation was found to have incomplete travel notes after initial acceptance. The file showed that the passenger briefing had not fully captured the carrier details, feeding guidance, and transfer expectations needed for safe handover. The matter was identified before check-in, which limited exposure, but it still required immediate correction because the journey depended on clear coordination between the desk, the passenger, and the airport service team.

I took control of the file and confirmed the booking details against the original request. I then contacted the passenger, explained the concern in plain terms, and requested the missing information without delay. The passenger responded cooperatively, and the animal's needs were confirmed with care. I updated the manifest notes, checked the carrier compliance points, and alerted the relevant ground team so that handling would remain consistent from acceptance through boarding. The desk also reviewed adjacent bookings to ensure no similar omission had been missed during the same intake period.

The handling was completed without disruption to the wider desk operation. The passenger record now reflects the full travel arrangement, and the team has been reminded to verify animal-specific notes at every handoff. I directed a follow-up review of intake practice and asked for closer peer checks on all companion animal files until confidence is restored. The service remains committed to calm, accurate support, and this incident reinforced that each journey must be treated as a shared responsibility. Companion Animal Travel Desk
